scope: Three final technical rows; project parameter truth separated from operating consequences

graphic_evidence.inspection: Parent directly viewed original-detail crop; position45 pressure label 16.0 bar.

supported_claims: Selected K11 pump execution has maximum working pressure 16 bar.
Same-zone AUPD selection states maximum and nominal system pressure 16.3 bar.
finding_adjudications.physical_consequence: Exact pressure at either pump connection and actual overload in every operating mode are not established. The final body explicitly preserves this limitation.
finding_adjudications.severity_assessment: Criticality of actual consequences not independently established by the published-value difference alone.
finding_adjudications.duplicate_control: Do not suppress F-009 solely because both refer to K11 and zone 3; they compare different pressure functions.

supported_claims: Specification position 45 assigns opening pressure 20 bar and heating zone 3.
K11 data sheet assigns maximum working pressure 16 bar; published difference is 4 bar.
finding_adjudications.counterevidence: Direct inspection of the saved original-detail crop reads position45 Rср=16.0 bar on the schematic. This contradicts treating 20 bar as the sole unambiguous project setting, but does not erase the specification entry.
finding_adjudications.physical_consequence: Actual installed setting, exact protected boundaries and sufficiency of protection are not established.
finding_adjudications.recommended_wording: В спецификации позиции 45 для отопления третьей зоны указано Рср.=20 бар, на схеме — 16 бар; допустимое рабочее давление выбранного К11 — 16 бар. Согласовать проектную уставку и проверить защиту с учётом схемы подключения и распределения давлений. Фактическая настройка клапана не установлена.
finding_adjudications.presentation_correction: Replace repeated headings клапан контура настроен на 20 бар with спецификация задаёт Рср.=20 бар.
finding_adjudications.severity_assessment: Do not infer a critical installed protection failure solely from conflicting design entries.
finding_adjudications.duplicate_control: Keep scheme-versus-specification identity and setting-versus-equipment comparison distinct even if displayed in one review item.

supported_claims: Authoritative MD prints test pressure as 12.5 кг/см.
Mass per length is not a pressure dimension; intended corrected unit and corresponding number are not specified by this line.
finding_adjudications.physical_consequence: No actual test pressure or test failure inferred; no automatic rewrite to kgf/cm².
finding_adjudications.section_assessment: Final technical section follows its stated test-parameter ambiguity; factual correctness is separate from final profile and severity policy.
finding_adjudications.duplicate_control: F-003 concerns normative references in the same paragraph, not the test-unit assertion.

limits: No hydraulic protection calculation or measurement of installed equipment.
Same-version graphic counterpart strengthens the bounded source comparison; no whole-project operating safety verdict.
No new engineer acceptance or final precision score.
